name: Android / ADB
description: Private USB identity plus structured ADB 1.0.32 diagnostics, artifacts, backup, file, package, and device-management workflows.
help_text: Operator Mode uses exact ADB 1.0.32 syntax and a temporary localhost-only server on DDK-reserved port 5038, killed after every job. ADB shell remains unavailable because arbitrary remote shell text would violate the no-generic-web-shell boundary.
